reference: Her friend asked why she had refused their jacket.
sk: Kamarátka sa spýtala, prečo ich bundu odmietla
cz: Kamarádka se zeptala, proč jejich bundu odmítla
acceptable: {Her|A} friend asked why she had {refused|rejected|turned down} their jacket.
{Her|A} friend asked why she had turned their jacket down.

mistakes.text: {Her|A} friend asked why she refused their jacket.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Odmietnutie bolo pred otázkou, preto je lepší Past Perfect: „had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Odmítnutí bylo před otázkou, proto je lepší Past Perfect: „had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The refusal came before the question, so the Past Perfect “had refused” is better.

mistakes.text: {Her|A} friend asked why had she refused their jacket.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V nepriamej otázke nie je inverzia: „why she had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V nepřímé otázce není inverze: „why she had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Reported questions use statement word order: “why she had refused”.

mistakes.text: {Her|A} friend asked why did she refuse their jacket.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Reported speech nepoužíva „did“: „why she had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Reported speech nepoužívá „did“: „why she had refused“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use “did” in a reported question: “why she had refused”.

mistakes.text: {Her|A} friend asked why she has refused their jacket.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po minulom „asked“ sa čas posúva: „she had refused“, nie „she has refused“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po minulém „asked“ se čas posouvá: „she had refused“, ne „she has refused“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After past “asked”, move the tense back: “she had refused”, not “has refused”.

mistakes.text: {Her|A} friend asked why she had refused her jacket.
mistakes.feedback_en: The jacket belongs to them: “their jacket”, not “her jacket”.

source_issues: Slovak and Czech have no possessive for the friend (Kamarátka/Kamarádka); 'A friend' is accepted as well as 'Her friend'.
